title: Wings live: Olympiahalle, Munich | 1976
content:
Wings performed at the Olympiahalle in Munich, Germany, on 27 September 1976.

It was the 62nd night of the 65-date Wings Over The World Tour, which ran from September 1975 to October 1976.

Wings were Paul McCartney on vocals, guitar, bass guitar, and keyboards; Linda McCartney on vocals and keyboards; Denny Laine on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Jimmy McCulloch on guitar and vocals; and Joe English on drums, plus a horns and brass section consisting of Howie Casey, Tony Dorsey, Steve Howard, and Thaddeus Richard.

Paul McCartney returned to the Olympiahalle on 20, 21, and 22 October 1989, and 9 September 1993.
